detail:
- **Documented**: 14 of 15 modules carry an author's summary

6 requirements: 6 checked.
label: tools
quotes: get-component
A thin wrapper module exposing a getComponent function that retrieves component data from shared runtime resources.
get-component-docs
A server-side function module that assembles and returns documentation for a design system component for consumption by MCP tooling.
get-component-stories
A small script module that exposes a single function to retrieve component stories, used by the build and check tooling as it reaches shared code at run time.
get-design-guide
Provides a single MCP tool function that retrieves the design guide content from shared resources for use by an AI agent.
get-patterns
Provides a get-patterns function that exposes pattern data from the shared module, likely backing an MCP tool for querying design patterns.
get-rules
Provides the MCP tool handler that returns design system rules shared from the project for an agent to consult.
get-template
Provides a single accessor function for retrieving the shared page template used to assemble a finished piece.
get-template-stops
This module defines a single function that retrieves the list of named stop points used by a page template, serving the template rendering and validation scripts.
get-tokens
This module exposes a getTokens function that retrieves the design token data from the shared layer for consumers elsewhere in the system.
list-components
Provides a single MCP tool handler that lists available design system components by delegating to shared logic.
list-templates
A module providing a function to list available templates.
search-components
Module Search-components exposes a function to search for components, likely by querying available components based on criteria such as name or type.
